mapper.select: SELECT tac.SEQ_NO as seqNo, /** 流水号 **/ tac.FEE_TYPE as feeType, /** 费用品种 **/ tac.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, /** 账套代码 **/ tac.REGIST_ORG as registOrg, /** 登记托管机构 **/ tac.PAY_CYCLE as payCycle, /** 支付频率 **/ to_char(tac.POSITION_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as positionStartDate, /** 计提开始日 **/ to_char(tac.POSITION_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as positionEndDate, /** 计提结束日 **/ tac.FEE_AMT_TOTAL as feeAmtTotal /** 区间费用金额 **/ FROM TRD_ACCOUNTMF_CONFIG tac WHERE tac.SEQ_NO != #{seqNo} AND tac.FEE_TYPE = #{feeType} AND tac.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND tac.REGIST_ORG = #{registOrg} AND tac.POSITION_END_DATE >= to_date(#{positionStartDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND tac.POSITION_START_DATE <= to_date(#{positionEndDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
